name: Graphify
shrinks: file reads and grep calls, with codebase knowledge graph queries
about: Builds a searchable knowledge graph from your codebase so agents can traverse the graph instead of reading whole files, reducing context and improving accuracy.

setup.purpose: Install the Graphify plugin for Claude Code

teardown.purpose: Uninstall the Graphify plugin from Claude Code

notes: Graphify builds its graph locally using tree-sitter AST analysis. After installation, run `graphify init` in your project to build the index.
Results go into a `graphify-out/` folder which can be committed to Git and auto-rebuilt after commits.
